notes.title: Wrecker is here!
notes.notes:
This game was a blast to develop and we hope you enjoy playing it! This is our second game published on steam and we couldn't be more excited.

The release of Wrecker also kicks off our [u]M1 project[/u], in which we will be creating a new game every 1-2 months. This means that our games will be hyper focused on simple and exciting game play much like Wrecker.

We can't wait to see what 2020 has in store for us,  and our little studio.

Also the best any one here can do is spicy mode, and even that's a challenge. Let us know if you get bored and we will add as many difficulties as you desire!

Check out our new website to follow what we are doing today!
